data.visual_description: Aerial drone shot of the Dubai skyline at sunset with the Burj Khalifa in the background, warm golden hour lighting.
data.dialogue: في دبي، الوقت هو كل شيء.
data.music_note: Upbeat modern Arabic fusion, fast tempo

data.visual_description: Extreme close-up of a sharp knife slicing through perfectly roasted, juicy chicken shawarma meat on a vertical spit.
data.music_note: Sizzling sound effects layered with rhythmic beat

data.visual_description: A chef's hands quickly spreading garlic sauce on fresh, warm pita bread with precision.
A delivery rider in a branded uniform putting on a helmet, looking confident, with a motorcycle parked in a busy Dubai street.
The delivery bike weaving through modern city traffic, motion blur of city lights in the background.
A customer opening the door of a luxury apartment, receiving the branded paper bag with a smile.
Close-up of the customer taking a big, satisfying bite of the shawarma wrap, eyes closed in enjoyment.
data.music_note: Music softens to focus on the crunch sound

data.visual_description: Top-down view of the full meal spread on a table with fries and pickles, vibrant colors.
